ko: 만왕의 왕 내 주께서 왜 고초 당했나
이 벌레 같은 날 위해 그 보혈 흘렸네
en: Why did my Savior bleed, And did my Sovereign die? Would He devote that sacred head For such a worm as I?

ko: 십자가 십자가 내가 처음 볼 때에
en: At the Cross, at the Cross,where I first saw the light, And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I an happy all the day!

ko: 주 십자가 못 박힘은 속죄함 아닌가
그 긍휼함과 큰 은혜 말할 수 없도다
en: Was it for crimes that I have done, He groaned upon the tree? Amazing pity, grace unknown, And love beyond degree!

ko: 십자가 십자가 내가 처음 볼 때에
en: At the Cross, at the Cross,where I first saw the light, And the burden of my heart rolled away
It was there by faith I received my sight,
And now I an happy all the day!

ko: 늘 울어도 그 큰 은혜 다 갚을 수 없네
나 주님께 몸 바쳐서 주의 일 힘쓰리
en: No tears of grief can ever repay The debt of love I owe Here, Lord, I give myself away is all that I can do!
